Key.English: Allow Server Reset

Lets Chronos reset player positions and clear saved vehicles at the mission start (by default on a map change; each server's rule and staff's choice in Logistics › Manage). Off: nothing is reset or remembered for this mission.

Key.English: Vehicles
ACE Cargo
Keeps what is loaded in vehicles' ACE cargo (objects with their inventory, and persistent vehicles loaded into others).
ACE Fuel and Ammo Supply
Keeps what ACE fuel and ammo trucks have left (finite fuel; limited or magazine-specific ammo supply).
Objects

Makes objects players place persistent (trenches, sandbags, fortifications, tripods) and keeps the saved objects that aren't vehicles (those, crates, other objects added to Chronos), with a trench's dig progress.
Pylons
Keeps aircraft pylon loadouts and their ammo.
Static Weapons
Makes static weapons and ACE CSW tripods persistent when a player deploys one, and keeps the saved ones.
Turret Ammo
Keeps the magazines and ammo left in vehicles' turrets. Off: vehicles come back with what they're made with.
